notes: Sources cross-checked: manufacturer data sheet (Bluesound-Professional-B400S-Data-Sheet.pdf) and the official Owner's Manual (Bluesound-Professional-B400S-OM_EN.pdf, rev v05 Sep 2019), both from bluesoundprofessional.com. The Owner's Manual rear-panel diagram and connector table were used as the primary authority since they are more detailed than the one-page data sheet. PREAMPLIFIER IN and PREAMPLIFIER OUT x4, +12V TRIGGER IN/OUT, IR IN, and SIGNAL BLOCK all use pluggable Phoenix-style terminal blocks, mapped here to "euroblock" (closest list match). PREAMPLIFIER IN doubles as a mic input with switchable +48V phantom power (LINE/MIC switch + Phantom ON/OFF switch) - noted on that port. SIGNAL BLOCK is a 4-position terminal block; only pins 1 and GND are currently used (pin +5V and pin 2 reserved for future software-defined use). USB Type-B (mini) port is explicitly documented as "for product servicing... not for consumer use" - included since it is a real physical port, but not intended for end-user I/O. AC inlet is a standard detachable IEC connector (confirmed by rear-panel photo showing a 3-pin IEC socket and the manual's mention of "two detachable mains power cord[s]" for different regions); auto-switching 100-240V 50/60Hz. No grades apply: RJ45 is Gigabit Ethernet but spec sheet only states "Gigabit" generically (interpreted as eth-1g); TOSLINK/RCA digital audio and Phoenix/Euroblock connectors are not part of any graded connector scale per the instructions, so no grade was set on those. Device is a 1U rack-mountable 4-zone network audio streamer/DSP player, not a full AV receiver or amplifier - categorized as "audio" / type "Audio interface" as the closest fit (no dedicated "network streamer" type exists in the provided enum).

ports.name: PREAMPLIFIER IN (LINE/MIC)
ports.note: Balanced Phoenix/Euroblock terminal block; switchable LINE/MIC with +48V phantom power option for mic use

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Host port for USB memory stick / mass-storage playback (FAT32/NTFS)

ports.name: SERVICE (USB Type-B mini)
ports.note: USB Type-B mini port for factory servicing only, not for consumer use; closest list match used since usb-b-mini is not a distinct id

ports.name: SIGNAL BLOCK
ports.note: 4-position terminal block for dry-contact/magnetic switch signal interrupt; only pins 1 and GND currently active

ports.name: AC MAINS INPUT
ports.note: Detachable IEC power inlet, 100-240V 50/60Hz auto-switching; two regional power cords supplied
